svg.title: From administrative handoff to a first reported Bohemia receipt
svg.desc: An original evidence timeline. January 1, 2024: Lakefront Management Authority assumed management of the Bohemia assets under an agreement described by counsel. February 20, 2024: Executive Director Louis Capo reported LMA received its first Bohemia payment, $7,500, without identifying payer, lease or period. March 26, 2025: Capo later sought an audit of mineral lease receipts. These are distinct records, not a reconciled royalty ledger or evidence of payments to heirs.

Editorial diagram, not a bank receipt or historical image.
svg.text: Three official milestones. Three different claims.
NONE OF THESE IS AN HEIR'S PAYMENT RECEIPT.
Sources: LMA 2024 committee records and March 2025 minutes.
